entities.label: NeuroCardioWatch
entities.evidence: NeuroCardioWatch is a hospital monitoring solution for continuous acquisition and analysis of EEG and ECG signals.

entities.label: EEG/ECG sensors
entities.evidence: A patient wears EEG/ECG sensors during monitoring.

entities.label: Patient Monitoring Device
entities.evidence: Sensors transmit signals to a bedside Patient Monitoring Device.

entities.label: Streaming Gateway
entities.evidence: The Patient Monitoring Device forwards signals to the Streaming Gateway over the hospital network, and the Streaming Gateway streams signals to the Real-Time Analytics Backend.

entities.label: Real-Time Analytics Backend
entities.evidence: The Real-Time Analytics Backend analyzes EEG/ECG streams to detect abnormal events and generates alert events with associated metadata.

entities.label: Notification Service
entities.evidence: It triggers the Notification Service, which delivers alerts to nurses and doctors according to configured escalation rules.

entities.label: Clinical Monitoring Dashboard
entities.evidence: Nurses and doctors review alert details and trends in the Clinical Monitoring Dashboard and acknowledge/annotate alerts.

entities.label: Electronic Health Record (EHR)
entities.evidence: The Real-Time Analytics Backend stores analysis summaries and alert metadata in the Electronic Health Record (EHR) system.

entities.label: Hospital Identity Provider
entities.evidence: Users of the Clinical Monitoring Dashboard authenticate via the Hospital Identity Provider. The Real-Time Analytics Backend authenticates via the Hospital Identity Provider when accessing protected resources and when writing to the EHR.

relationships.label: displays
relationships.evidence: The Real-Time Analytics Backend stores analysis summaries and alert metadata in the Electronic Health Record (EHR) system. Bedside devices (EEG/ECG sensors and the Patient Monitoring Device) do not write to the EHR; EHR writes occur only via the backend. The dashboard displays clinical data and does not bypass backend-controlled authorization when accessing or exporting EHR-relevant summaries.
